label: R17-FP-ACC-CONTROL-CUT
title: Cut core pipeline control and register-index fanout into FP accumulation
model_selection: spawn_agent/followup_task omits model; user-confirmed default gpt-5.6-luna[max]
dependency_override: Speculative timing implementation starts from the repaired T-009 candidate while its broad functional validation is still running; this lane may not integrate until T-009 is done and requires new post-integration physical evidence.
scope: Remove the shared exmem_valid/exmem_wb_rd/memwb_wb_rd -> decode -> sys_commit_ready -> fp_rsp_ready control cone from the FP transaction accumulator clock enable. The preferred local cut is to retain acc/acc_flags after the TX_DONE response handshake, because the held response is already independent and the next accepted request clears both accumulators in TX_IDLE. Preserve exact response hold, request ownership, scalar/NEON FMA operand_c, tag, single outstanding transaction, kill/reset, and commit ordering.
write_regions: sim/cocotb/test_p7_3_neon_fp.py::response backpressure and consecutive transaction checks
forbidden_regions: rtl/lcvex_pkg.sv public interfaces unless the integrator first approves
false paths, assertion disable, or reference-result changes
pre_batch_validation: static request/ownership/hazard/reset/kill/hold review only while the T-009 heavy queue is occupied
batch_acceptance_tests: FP exec directed SV and Cocotb including FMA operand_c and response backpressure
core backpressure and V RAW dependency tests
P7-1/P7-3/P7-4/P7-5 SV+Cocotb and strict lockstep matrices
affected IRQ/fault/restore tests for transaction cancellation
acceptance: TX_DONE response ready no longer drives acc/acc_flags write enable, so the reported 27-level control cone has no accumulator endpoint. The stale accumulator is non-architectural, remains ignored in TX_IDLE, and is cleared on the next request acceptance as well as reset/kill. Backpressure cannot duplicate, lose, or expose a younger FP effect. The owner stops after implementation, directed test updates, and static review; integration and all simulation/physical claims require the batch integrator and new physical reports.

review.summary: TX_DONE cleanup change passed exact-SHA functional validation and the old cone left global top-50; broad core-control-to-acc/flags paths remain nonzero and are carried into T-018.

review_result.notes: Independent review accepted the local TX_DONE accumulator-enable cut after the directed test established both MEM/WB and EX/MEM occupancy. Full joint simulation and new physical STA remain pending.

board_policy: No assembler, bitstream generation, JTAG, programming, power-on, or board test without explicit user permission.
